selection: Checkpoint and learning-rate choice by validation species macro-F1, then classification cross-entropy. Same two-rate budget in every condition.
design: 400 fixed train/val images: 200 class-labelled training and 200 validation; 40 training and 20 validation images receive assistant-reviewed visible-attribute labels. Same training sample set across optimization seeds. No test images are encoded or evaluated.
supervision: Sixteen image-visible traits, unknown and non-applicable entries masked. Approximate evidence boxes guide attribute-specific patch attention during training only. Shuffled control permutes training annotations and boxes across species within insect/plant groups.
model: Frozen official image/text encoders. Train separate low-rank global/patch residual adapters, attribute calibration and an additive attribute-to-class linear branch. All region variants share the same architecture. Baseline omits the attribute branch. No auxiliary labels or boxes are inputs at prediction time.
limitations: Exploratory validation reused for development; assistant labels are provisional, not expert ground truth. Sparse annotation and some whole-organism evidence boxes limit attribute and localization conclusions. No gain is assumed.
